care.summary: Tropical rhizome spice grown for fresh ginger; prefers filtered sun, warmth, and rich moist soil.
care.light: Bright filtered sun / morning sun + afternoon shade in tropics
care.water: Keep moist in growth; reduce when foliage yellows toward harvest
care.soil: Loose, rich, well-draining mix high in organic matter
care.fertilizer: Monthly balanced liquid feed during active growth
care.toxicity: Rhizome edible; generally pet-safe in food amounts
common_issues: Rhizome rot in cold wet soil
care.climate_notes: Excellent tropical/subtropical outdoor crop; lift or mulch heavily if frost risk exists.
